postgres_requirements.setup_manifest: UNKNOWN - the implementing mission supplies the disposable-harness setup manifest that applies the full chain stella_0013 through stella_0018 and then stella_0017b. It is not named here because it depends on artifacts this manifest does not author.
postgres_requirements.rationale: The load-bearing claims of this node are PostgreSQL catalog and transaction facts, and no static text check can substitute for them. That a SQL file CONTAINS a nine-argument signature does not prove the database HOLDS it, that the old seven-argument form is GONE, that pronargdefaults is 0, that uellix_stella_ops holds exactly eight functions, that the revised functions are SECURITY DEFINER with search_path empty, or that the EXECUTE topology survived. Three claims are specifically unprovable anywhere else: that risk_level and risk_flags land on the durable stella_interactions row in the SAME transaction as quota settlement; that an idempotent replay preserves the ORIGINAL values rather than refreshing them; and that the predecessor installed-probe and package-witness remain TRUE after a CORRECT supersession - the inversion this node exists to prevent is invisible to every static check because the inverted probes are syntactically perfect. Via pnpm db:audit:disposable against a fresh throwaway container which is destroyed afterwards - NEVER staging, NEVER hosted, NEVER production, NEVER the canonical local Supabase stack.

sentinels.purpose: A synthetic risk_level value of high, paired with a synthetic risk_flags array, planted through the governed completion path so the probe can prove the values arrive on the durable stella_interactions row rather than only in the audit_logs trail. Fictional test data, never a real interaction.

A second, deliberately DIFFERENT risk payload replayed under the SAME (organization_id, idempotency_key). Proves ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING preserved the first payload; if the stored values change to the second payload, DO NOTHING was silently converted to DO UPDATE.

A database holding stella_0017b and NOT holding the dropped seven-argument and ten-argument signatures. Used to prove the predecessor probe and witness still resolve stella_0017 as INSTALLED. This sentinel state is exactly the state in which every current sentinel inverts.

positive_controls.description: EXACT FUNCTION COUNT. uellix_stella_ops holds exactly 8 functions after stella_0017b applies. Asserted as an equality, never as a lower bound and never as a contains. One DROP plus one CREATE of the completion verb is count-neutral.
The nine-argument uellix_stella_ops.complete_operation_ticket is PRESENT, taking the seven prior arguments plus p_risk_level and p_risk_flags.
The twelve-argument uellix_stella.settle_reserved_quota is PRESENT, taking the ten prior arguments plus p_risk_level varchar(50) and p_risk_flags text[].

The five-argument delegator EXISTS, is a delegator, and resolves to the twelve-argument implementation - proven by reading its definition and confirming it calls settle_reserved_quota with a seven-NULL tail.

RISK DURABILITY. A governed completion carrying RISK-SENTINEL-HIGH lands risk_level and risk_flags on the public.stella_interactions row, read back inside the SAME transaction as the quota settlement, under the same per-organization advisory lock.
SECURITY DEFINER is set on every revised function - the twelve-argument settle, the five-argument delegator and the nine-argument completion verb.
search_path is the empty string on every revised function.
EXECUTE topology preserved: the payload-carrying conversion is executable by uellix_cap_stella_ticket, and the sibling completion verb is executable by uellix_app.
The risk vocabulary CHECK stella_interactions_risk_level_check is present and unchanged, still admitting NULL, low, medium and high.
SUCCESSOR PROBE. Against a database in SUCCESSION-SENTINEL-0017 state, the stella_0017 installed probe resolves TRUE. The predecessor does not read as absent after a correct supersession.

SUCCESSOR WITNESS. Against the same database, the PACKAGE_WITNESSES resolution reports stella_0017 INSTALLED and stella_0017b INSTALLED, the latter discriminated by the nine-argument signature no prior unit publishes.
CHECKPOINT A1 COHERENCE. The regenerated corroboration reports no installed package as absent, and pnpm a1:observation:verify passes by byte comparison.
CHAIN POSITION. stella_0017b_governed_risk_parameters is the LAST element of STELLA_TICKET_PACKAGE_CHAIN, and stella_0018 retains its prior index - proving a tail append rather than an interleave.

SUPERSESSION ENTRY. PREPARED_PACKAGE_SUPERSESSIONS holds an entry with packageName stella_0017_governed_stella_consumption and supersededBy stella_0017b_governed_risk_parameters, with all five interface fields populated and the probe a fixed literal SQL string that is never composed at runtime.

ROLLBACK RESTORES THE PREDECESSOR SHAPE. After stella_0017b_rollback.sql, the seven-argument complete and ten-argument settle are present, the five-argument delegator points at the ten-argument form, the EXECUTE topology matches the prior state, and uellix_stella_ops is back to exactly 8 functions.
GENERATED PARITY. The hosted and governed variants regenerate byte-identically from the canonical unit, and the governed source and generated digests pin the T12 entry.
README INVENTORY. Every member of STELLA_TICKET_PACKAGE_CHAIN, including stella_0017b, appears in the db/prepared/README.md inventory with a section and a table row.
PROTECTED SET COMPLETENESS. All six protected literals exist and are non-empty after the implementation act.

TRANSFER-SEGMENT PIN RE-DERIVED. tests/hosted/authority/remediation-certification.test.ts asserts deriveTransferSegmentCount() at its re-derived value (expected 13, up from the pinned 11) and the eleven pre-existing governed pins remain byte-identical, proving one window was ADDED rather than an existing one re-anchored or re-split.

SUPERSESSION REGISTRY IS COMPLETE AND PLURAL. Every predecessor whose re-application would clobber stella_0017b has its own (predecessor, successor) entry with all five interface fields populated, and every supersession guard that refuses today STILL refuses against a database in SUCCESSION-SENTINEL-0017 state. Proven by running the registry, never by inspecting it.

negative_controls.description: The OLD seven-argument complete_operation_ticket is ABSENT. to_regprocedure over it returns NULL after apply.
The OLD ten-argument settle_reserved_quota is ABSENT.
NO DEFAULT PARAMETERS. pronargdefaults is 0 for every overload of complete_operation_ticket and for the revised settle functions.
The five-argument delegator body contains NO INSERT INTO public.stella_interactions - the same assertion shape stella_0017 uses at its own lines 899 and 912.
The nine-argument completion verb body contains NO INSERT INTO public.stella_interactions; it charges THROUGH the conversion. Exactly one writer of the ledger survives.
uellix_app holds NO EXECUTE on the ticketless consumption surface, and PUBLIC holds no forbidden EXECUTE on the revised functions.

NO ROW IS WRITTEN WITH A RISK LEVEL OUTSIDE THE VOCABULARY. A completion attempting an out-of-vocabulary risk_level is REFUSED by stella_interactions_risk_level_check rather than silently coerced or dropped.

THE GROUNDED PATH IS UNDISTURBED. The three-argument complete_operation_ticket still exists, still converts its reservation, and never calls consume_stella_quota - the property stella_0017 section 4 item 13 already asserts.
NO CONSUMER READS audit_logs FOR RISK. The readiness gate obtains risk_level from stella_interactions and a probe confirms no governed risk consumer queries audit_logs.

NO APPLIED UNIT IS EDITED. The implementation diff contains neither db/prepared/stella_0017_governed_stella_consumption.sql, nor stella_0017_rollback.sql, nor stella_0018_...sql, nor stella_hosted_0001_rollback.sql, nor any hosted or governed twin of those.
NO HISTORICAL EVIDENCE IS REWRITTEN. The implementation diff contains no file under docs/ops/staging/evidence/.

NO WILDCARD GRANT. ods:scope run with the six exact literals returns ok, and the act contains no write under db/prepared/ outside those six. A run with db/prepared/** as the allow is rejected at allocation because it makes the negative vacuous.

NO REMOTE APPLY. Every PostgreSQL proof in this manifest runs against a disposable throwaway container that is destroyed afterwards; no probe targets staging, hosted, production or the canonical local Supabase stack.
stella_0017b IS NOT INTERLEAVED. stella_0017b does not appear between stella_0017 and stella_0018 in STELLA_TICKET_PACKAGE_CHAIN, and no existing chain index shifts.

mutation_controls.description: MUT-053-1/2/3/4. Omitting any one of the four stella_0017b artifacts is CAUGHT - by the six-literal presence control for the canonical unit and rollback, by hosted-manifest parity for the hosted variant, and by governed regeneration byte-comparison for the governed variant.
MUT-053-5. Omitting the db/prepared/README.md section is CAUGHT by the inventory control asserting every chain member appears in the README.
MUT-053-6. Hand-editing db/prepared/checkpoint-a1/corroboration.sql instead of regenerating it is CAUGHT by pnpm a1:observation:verify, which regenerates and compares BYTES.
MUT-053-7. Widening the grant to db/prepared/** is CAUGHT at allocation. Recorded as a mutation because a wide allow makes N-12 pass vacuously - the negative appears green while proving nothing.

MUT-053-8. Registering the WRONG supersession predecessor - stella_0018 or stella_0016 instead of stella_0017 - is CAUGHT by a control pinning both packageName and supersededBy to their exact literals.
MUT-053-9. Interleaving the package into the middle of the chain is CAUGHT by the tail-position control (N-14, P-13).

MUT-053-10. Retaining the old seven-argument complete alongside the new one is CAUGHT by the absence assertion N-1 AND by the count equality P-1. Two independent controls, because a count alone would pass if something else were dropped to compensate.

MUT-053-11. Retaining the old ten-argument settle is CAUGHT by N-2. The count control does NOT cover this one, because settle lives in uellix_stella rather than uellix_stella_ops - so the absence assertion is load-bearing on its own.
MUT-W3-7 / MUT-053-12. Adding the risk parameters with DEFAULTs via CREATE OR REPLACE, producing an overload, is CAUGHT by pronargdefaults = 0 (N-3) plus the count equality (P-1).
MUT-W3-6 / MUT-053-13. Giving the five-argument delegator a self-contained body with its own INSERT is CAUGHT by N-4. The guarantee is that the ledger holds ONE INSERT reached by two arities.
MUT-W3-8 / MUT-053-14. Satisfying the contract by continuing to write risk only to audit_logs is CAUGHT by P-5, which reads the value back off the durable row inside the transaction.
MUT-053-15. Converting ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING to DO UPDATE so a replay refreshes the risk values is CAUGHT by RISK-SENTINEL-REPLAY: the second, different payload must NOT appear in the stored row.
MUT-053-16. Hand-editing a generated hosted or governed artifact is CAUGHT by pnpm authority:verify regeneration plus the source and generated digest pins.

MUT-053-17. Leaving STELLA_0017_INSTALLED_PROBE written over the dropped seven-argument signature is CAUGHT by P-10. This control FAILS today by construction, which is the proof that it is not vacuous.

MUT-053-18. Leaving the PACKAGE_WITNESSES entry for stella_0017 naming the two dropped signatures is CAUGHT by P-11. Also failing today by construction. Tracked separately from M-14 because the probe and the witness are DIFFERENT predicate shapes in DIFFERENT files with DIFFERENT signature spellings; repairing one does not repair the other.

MUT-053-19. Regenerating the A1 corroboration while the witness registry still carries inverted arms is CAUGHT by P-12, which asserts no installed package reports absent. A byte-comparison alone would pass, because the generator would faithfully emit the inverted arms.

MUT-053-20. Applying stella_0017b while the deployed runtime still calls the seven-argument signature is CAUGHT by an apply gate that refuses while the companion runtime node is open. This is the machine form of the authority's RUNTIME_APPLY_COUPLING and is the one control whose subject lies OUTSIDE this node's write set.

MUT-053-21. Applying the unit to a remote or hosted target under a rehearsal framing is CAUGHT by N-13 plus the G2 boundary refusal. A rehearsal is a throwaway container that is destroyed, never a remote target.
MUT-053-22. Repairing the stella_0018 preflight or the stella_hosted_0001_rollback witness by EDITING those applied units is CAUGHT by N-10, which asserts neither file appears in the diff.

T-NUMBER MISALLOCATION. Allocating stella_0017b as T8b, or renumbering T9 through T11 to make room, is CAUGHT by a control asserting the eleven existing governed pins are byte-identical and that exactly one pin was appended - the same shape the file's own T11 comment already used.

F-PC-2. Appending stella_0017b without re-deriving deriveTransferSegmentCount() is CAUGHT by the hardcoded pin at remediation-certification.test.ts:454, which asserts toBe(11). The mutation is invisible to a write set derived from the stella_0019/T11 precedent, because T10 and T11 contribute ZERO OWNER_TRANSFER segments while T8 contributes two.

F-PC-4 / F-053-10. Registering ONE supersession entry for stella_0017b instead of one per clobbering predecessor, or leaving the two entries probed on STELLA_0017_INSTALLED_PROBE unadvanced, is CAUGHT by re-applying stella_0015 and stella_0016 against a SUCCESSION-SENTINEL-0017 database and asserting BOTH are REFUSED with a named reason. A silenced guard passes every static check, so only the live refusal proves it.

F-053-8. Declaring an unregistered known_condition id is NOT caught by JSON Schema — measured: a mutant carrying an invented KTC id passes ajv. It is caught only by cross-checking docs/ops/ods/KNOWN_TEST_CONDITIONS_v1.0.0.json, or by pnpm ops:test-diff. Recorded as a mutation because schema validity here is necessary and not sufficient.
